name: LinkButton
intent: Combine anchor semantics with Button visuals.

figmaSource.notes: The Figma `tone` variant `inverse` maps to the code-level `isInverse` boolean (an orthogonal on-dark treatment), not to a code `tone` value. The inverse variants mirror the `subtle` tone (transparent fill) retinted to the inverse content + white subtle overlay tokens.

behaviorRules: Routes to another page or location.

Supports isInverse (boolean) as an orthogonal on-dark treatment for placement on dark/bold surfaces such as Banner - transparent fill, inverse content, and the color-background-neutral-overlay-subtle-* overlays on hover/press; flattened by isDisabled like tone.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports the inverse treatment (isInverse) for placement on dark or bold-colored surfaces
